title: Support my new twitch tv channel
description: What's up tubers... Just wanted to let everyone know that my new twitch tv channel is up and running. Please stop by and follow that channel so you will know whenever I am live streaming. I look forward to seeing you on the next stream... Happy Holidays!  Here is the link: www.twitch.tv/electronictruthtv  Credits: Electronic Truth TV - Ichi Music By: "Cut and Run" Kevin MacLeod (incompetech.com) Licensed under Creative Commons: By Attribution 3.0http://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/3.0/

asr.full_text: What's up tubies? It's your boy Edgey and I just wanted to say HAPPY HOLIDAYS FIRST! I hope everything is going well for everyone , I hope you got everything you wanted for Christmas, and I also wanted to remind you guys and let you guys know, those of you that didn't know, that I am now up and streaming live live on twitch tv so please do and check me out, you can see me on twitch.tv or electronic truth TV and i will put the link on the screen right now please go and share your support and follow this channel and so it could be successful I've been doing a lot of random streams just when i really feel like it is really fun I say some crazy stuff that you probably don't get a lot anymore. and this will be the only way you'll be seeing gameplay on my channel. I will be streaming it live, all on Twitch. Go check out that Twitch channel and follow it to get an alert everytime I'm on. I can't guarantee that I'll be on a scheduled video. Because I'm working a normal can't guarantee that I'll be able to set schedule due to the fact that I work a normal job outside of doing YouTube. So please go and show your support follow that channel, I encourage you to comment and chat with me I'm watching it live as I'm playing and I will talk back to you. I also play with subscribers while I'm live streaming. This is the perfect opportunity for you guys to jump in there on the other side of this, I'm gonna put down a new channel that's gonna grow while and even grow my channel and I mean, especially a few of you guys watching us on the YouTube community as well, a couple of you guys should get the channel on some of the other channels that I'm watching and maybe also I also got these subscribers. For all of you subscribers while I'm live streaming, perfect opportunity for you guys to jump in there and interact and let's have some fun and I need your help. So let's get this channel to grow. still believe i know for a fact that I have the best subs in the whole YouTube community, so please take some time, go over to Twitch look me up electronic truth TV Right now im only playing battlefield 4 and call of duty ghost because i don't have other games i will at some point be getting an xbox one I kind of assume, before titan fall I will be streaming titan fall i'll be streaming The Order i'll be streaming it kinda soon before Titanfall and when that comes out I'll be streaming the order all different games And I'll also be taking requests for the stream So umm yeah this one's for you guys Go check me out twitch.tv electronic truth TV Follow that channel I promise you, you'll not be sorry That's all I got Thank you so much for listening to me rant for a second guys Again show you support I'll see you in the next video Peace

annotation.contextual_rationale: This video is non-scam content because it promotes the creator's Twitch channel for live gameplay and asks viewers to follow, interact in chat, and receive streaming alerts. The visible Twitch URL and subscription prompt are consistent with ordinary channel promotion and audience engagement, without a described payment requirement, credential request, deceptive promise, or transaction outcome.
annotation.fine_grained_rationale: The central subject is general entertainment through live video-game streaming, including gameplay, subscriber interaction, and stream requests.
